How it works

Step 1

Estimate in seconds

Enter your load weight, service and metro above. You get a low / expected / high range built only from sourced 2026 prices — no made-up numbers.

Step 2

Send the request pack

Download, copy or email the auto-written request to 2–3 laundromats near you. It asks for the per-lb rate, minimums, turnaround and fees — everything needed for a firm quote.

Step 3

Compare & book direct

Firms reply with real quotes. Pick the best, set your pickup day, and your laundry comes back washed, folded and ready to put away.

Straight talk about how this site works

This site sends nothing to any laundromat. The estimator runs in your browser, and the request pack is yours to download, copy or email to firms you choose. Direct firm matching is a future launch model only — it is not live, and no firm pays to appear here today.

Why pickup & delivery beats the laundromat run

The median gap between drop-off ($1.75/lb) and pickup & delivery ($1.99/lb) is just $0.24/lb — about $4.80 on a 20 lb load. For that, you skip two car trips, the waiting, the folding, and the lost Saturday morning. On a weekly rhythm, most households land at $60–$120 a month — less than most families spend on streaming and takeout coffee combined.

  • Washed, dried and folded to put-away standard
  • Typical turnaround 24–48 hours; same-day where offered
  • Recurring weekly or fortnightly slots — set it and forget it
  • Local firms in secondary metros compete on price and service

Laundry pickup for every kind of week

However your laundry piles up, there is a version of this service built for it. Each pack below starts from the same estimator — just pick your service type above.

Most searched

Wash and fold pickup near me

The core service: bag it, leave it out, get it back folded. Budget at the $1.99/lb pickup & delivery median, and compare 2–3 local firms with the request pack — per-lb rates in the same metro can span the full $1.00–$2.50 range.

Families

Laundry delivery for busy families

Kids generate laundry daily. A weekly 30–40 lb family order typically lands in the $30–$75 weekly band. Set a fixed pickup day and the mountain never forms — school uniforms and sports kits come back ready.

Hosts

Laundry for Airbnb hosts

Sheets, towels and duvet covers between every stay, on a same-day or next-day rhythm. Ask firms about per-turnaround pricing, stain treatment and a standing pickup after each checkout — turnover laundry is a business cost, so keep the invoices.

Students

Student laundry pickup

Dorm and off-campus pickup saves the Sunday laundromat queue. Watch the minimums: with a $30–$55 floor common, a fortnightly bigger load often beats two tiny weekly ones. Split a bag with a roommate and split the floor too.

Per item

Dry cleaning pickup

Suits, dresses and delicates are priced per item, not per lb — so the winning move is asking for the full per-item list before the first pickup. The request pack asks for exactly that, plus turnaround for formal wear.

Bulky items

Bedding & comforter laundry

Comforters, duvets and blankets rarely fit home machines well. Most firms price these per item; send the pack with your item count and ask about hypoallergenic wash options and drying time for thick fills.

Urgent

Same-day laundry

Spills before a trip, a uniform needed tomorrow — same-day exists in many metros at a surcharge of about $0.25–$0.75/lb. Ask about the cut-off time for pickup; miss it and you are on next-day by default.

Plans

Subscription laundry plans

Regulars save hassle with flat-bag or monthly plans. National reference points: Rinse charges $45 (Flex) / $75 (Full) per bag plus a $14.95 pickup & delivery fee; Poplin runs $1/lb with a $30 minimum. Ask local firms what their recurring-customer deal is — many will match the convenience.

Seniors

Laundry for seniors

No heavy baskets, no basement stairs, no driving with laundry. Doorstep pickup with the same driver each week, large-print invoices and gentle detergents on request — ask firms about senior discounts and caregiver scheduling.

Business

Small-business, gym & salon linen laundry

Towels, robes, uniforms, table linen and gym kit on a contract rhythm. Commercial accounts usually negotiate per-lb rates at volume — send the pack with your estimated weekly weight and ask for the commercial rate card and a trial week.

What to ask before you book

  • Exact per-lb rate — and whether pickup & delivery costs extra
  • Minimum order (lb or $) and any delivery or service fees
  • Turnaround time, and the same-day cut-off if you need it
  • Detergent choices — hypoallergenic, scent-free, eco
  • How delicates, bedding and dry-clean items are priced
  • Lost-or-damaged item policy, in writing
  • Recurring-plan discount for weekly or fortnightly slots

Every one of these questions is already written into the request pack above.

Frequently asked questions

How much does laundry pickup and delivery cost in the USA in 2026?

The median price for pickup and delivery wash and fold is $1.99 per lb, based on prices read from 1,753 US laundromats in October 2026 (LaundryRank). Drop-off wash and fold median is $1.75 per lb. The typical national range is $1.00 to $2.50 per lb.

How much does a typical weekly laundry order cost?

A typical weekly order costs $30 to $75, and most households spend $60 to $120 per month on laundry service, according to 2026 price guides. Many services apply a minimum of 10 to 15 lb or a $30 to $55 order floor.

Does this site send my request to a laundromat?

No. This site sends nothing to any laundromat. The estimator runs entirely in your browser and builds a request pack that you download, copy or email yourself to firms you choose. Matching you directly with firms is a future launch model only.

How much laundry is in a pound?

As a rough guide, a standard laundry bag or a week's clothes for one adult is often around 10 to 15 lb. Use the estimator slider to test different weights and see the price range change instantly.

Is same-day laundry more expensive?

Usually yes. 2026 guides put the same-day surcharge at about $0.25 to $0.75 extra per lb on top of the standard per-lb rate, where the service is offered.

How is dry cleaning and bedding priced?

Dry cleaning and bulky bedding such as comforters are usually priced per item rather than per lb. Use the estimator's per-lb range as a budgeting guide, then ask each firm for its per-item price list in your request pack.

Which cities does this site focus on?

This site focuses on US secondary metros such as Austin, Charlotte, Columbus, Denver, Nashville, Phoenix, Raleigh, San Antonio, Tampa and Las Vegas, rather than New York, San Francisco, Chicago and Los Angeles where national apps already dominate.
